mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_consents (user_id, purpose, granted, document_version, source, platform, app_version, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{purpose}, #{granted}, #{documentVersion}, #{source}, #{platform}, #{appVersion}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (purpose) id, user_id, purpose, granted, document_version, source, platform, app_version, created_at FROM user_consents WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY purpose, created_at DESC
SELECT granted FROM user_consents WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purpose = #{purpose} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
